messages:
maria-fin: Heads up — found ~$47,200 mismatch between billed hosted usage and Dedicated reservations in the March export. Looks like some Dedicated consumption got billed to Hosted SKU. Need GL impact and proposed deferral/accrual treatment.

james-rev: On it. Which accounts are affected?

maria-fin: Acct: AcmeCorp (acct_id 12345) and NimbusAI (acct_id 67890). The export shows 'hosted.generations' lines while pool_id for those rows should be the Dedicated pool.

sara-inv: Can you paste a few invoice line examples and the invoice numbers? I can route a credit request but need invoice refs and proposed JE.

maria-fin: Snippet from export (redacted):
```
invoice_num,account_id,sku,units,amount,pool_id
INV-2026-0345,12345,hosted.generations,120000,30200,
INV-2026-0370,67890,hosted.generations,80000,17000,
INV-2026-0345,12345,dedicated.reservation,0,0,POOL-DC-1
```

billing-bot: Billing export uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/monthly/2026-03/export_1768001234.csv (sha256: abcdef1234).

james-rev: Looks like ingestion left pool_id blank for some rows — likely parser edge-case when a migration happened mid-bill cycle. I can repro and create a mapping to reclassify. For close: we should book an accrual for unbilled/incorrectly recognized hosted revenue of $47,200 and reverse recognized revenue where applicable.

aaron-sales: AcmeCorp moved onto Dedicated on Feb 15 per the SOW — they should not be billed hosted rates after that. We already discussed manual credits with the customer rep.

sara-inv: Draft JE proposal: DR Unbilled Receivables $47,200; CR Revenue $47,200 (to pull back recognized hosted rev and set it as deferred/unbilled until correct billing runs). I'll include customer invoice refs and original hosted lines in the narrative. Need approval from finance leadership.

maria-fin: Tagging for approvals: @cody-cfo and @lina-legal — need quick sign-off to include in the month-end pack. Also tagging @eng-billing to fix ingestion for reprocess.

cody-cfo: Provisional approval to book the accrual and reverse recognized revenue pending final tie-out to invoices and the reprocessed export. Please add a clear explanation in the close checklist and save supporting files. :thumbsup:

lina-legal: Confirmed AcmeCorp commit effective Feb 15 in contract. Nimbus migration ticket shows cutover Mar 2. No unusual contract terms likely to change rev treatment beyond normal proration.

sara-inv: I'll prepare JE and include amortization plan for any deferred revenue (propose 10-month amortization for the portion tied to committed Dedicated usage). Will also raise a billing credit request for the hosted invoice lines.

eng-billing: Ack. We have a parser bug that drops pool_id when the migration flag is set and the line item has a legacy sku. We'll patch and re-run the exporter. ETA EOD tomorrow; will post updated S3 path and a diff.

maria-fin: Thanks — once you post the corrected export, I'll rerun the schedule, confirm the deferral amounts, and finalize the close pack. If reprocess changes numbers materially, we'll update the JE and notify CloseOps.

sara-inv: Filing the provisional JE and attaching current exports + narrative. Will mark as PENDING_REPROCESS until eng-billing updates the export.

maria-fin: Perfect. We should also capture this as a control deficiency for the month (billing ingestion). Adding to the close notes so auditors see remediation steps.

james-rev: I'll follow up tomorrow after the reprocess and post a reconciled worksheet. Thanks everyone
